_help.about: Where camp fires — the safe zones you can wake at after dying — are found (design 29 Sept 2026: only in the rare ruins). Restart after editing.
_help.only_at_ruins: true: camps exist only at inhabited ruins (about half of them) and at the opening encampment; the wild riverside camps and the cliff rock shelters are not placed, and wanderers never make a fire for you. false: the older rule (nearest camp of any kind).
_help.wake_random: true: after a death you wake at a RANDOM inhabited ruin's fire within wake_radius_m of where you died, a different one each time; false: the nearest.
_help.wake_radius_m: How far from where you died the fire can be. If no inhabited ruin lies within it the search widens (x2, up to widen_steps times); failing that you wake at the opening camp.
_help.wake_at_home: Design 30 Sept §AY: true (ambient profile) - after a death you wake at your HEARTH: the opening camp until you make another camp's fire your hearth (right click it). Overrides wake_random. false: the 29 Sept rule.
_help.sim: Design 30 Sept §BL–§BN, the camp simulation. Every number here is a first guess unless the note says 'Mike'; tune by play. tick_game_h: the sim steps once per game hour and catches up missed ticks on load (camps grow while unloaded). store: what a camp banks (wood and food, both VISIBLE as a woodpile and a food store; no HUD) and how many days' worth the folk try to keep. loop: the folk's safe daytime gather loop. population: start 3-5 (Mike), forage_cap, what a fundamental or a crop adds, the tribal ceiling (~24, Mike to confirm). births: need a man and a woman, a surplus, a slow clock; a child grows up in ~40 game days (Mike to confirm vs an adult after a delay). collapse: what takes a camp — fuel reach stripped, the fire low, the dark walks in; survivors walk to the nearest fire (some got on the way); starvation moves them instead. embers_game_h: a camp fire's embers linger this long so it can be saved. abandon: an empty camp is a ruin after ruin_after_game_days and the forest takes it back over forest_takes_game_days. restraint: take vs regrow. ladder: fire -> food -> storage -> specialist -> exchange; specialists appear at the storage rung (headman, plantkeeper) and where the site allows (maker). wildfire: rare; needs all three.
